caption: The drawing depicts a single green bonnet with a slightly shiny texture, suggesting it may be made from silk or satin. The bonnet is predominantly green, with smoother, dark green panels making up most of its surface, rounded at the front and gathered toward the back. The edges are slightly ruffled, particularly along the rear lower edge. At the top, the bonnet is decorated with a ribbon that features a checked or striped pattern in different shades of green and possibly some black, folded and sewn into a series of overlapping loops or gathers. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. The artist's signature is visible to the left of the bonnet near the lower edge of the image.
title: Hat
